briefdescription.para: Projects a 3D ray in Godot camera space onto the camera plane (Z = 0 plane in camera space).

parameterdescription.para: Unit ray direction in camera space.

simplesect.para: Vector3 Intersection point on camera plane, or (INFINITY, INFINITY, INFINITY) if parallel.

memberdef.argsstring: (const Vector3 &p_origin_cam, const Vector3 &p_direction_cam, const CanvasItem *p_local_to=nullptr) const
memberdef.name: project_ray_to_canvas

briefdescription.para: Projects a 3D ray in Godot camera space onto the physical display surface and transforms the hit position into canonical 2D Viewport Canvas space (or relative to a specified CanvasItem).

detaileddescription.para: Automatically accounts for physical camera offsets, screen size and pitch from the active GazeDeviceProfile, the current window position on screen, and display DPI scaling.

parameterdescription.para: Unit ray direction in camera space.
Optional CanvasItem (Node2D or Control). If null (default), returns position in canonical root Viewport Canvas coordinates. If specified, transforms the point into the local space of that CanvasItem.

simplesect.para: Vector2 Intersection point in canvas space or local coordinates, or (INFINITY, INFINITY) if no intersection.

briefdescription.para: Projects a 3D ray in Godot camera space onto the physical display surface and returns window-relative logical points.

detaileddescription.para: Returns coordinates in unscaled window points before Viewport canvas transformation.

parameterdescription.para: Unit ray direction in camera space.

simplesect.para: Vector2 Intersection point in window logical points, or (INFINITY, INFINITY) if no intersection.

briefdescription.para: Enables or disables mouse-to-gaze input emulation.

detaileddescription.para: When enabled, mouse cursor movement and clicks synthesize InputEventGaze events during development or when camera tracking is absent/occluded.
